fields.content:
Build a comprehensive list of ALL plausible candidate players who satisfy the following constraints, with full evidence and citations:

Goal:
Identify men’s international Twenty20 (T20I) matches before 2023 (i.e., up to 2022-12-31 inclusive) in which the Player/Man of the Match (POTM/MOTM):
- Took more than two wickets (i.e., at least 3 wickets),
- Conceded more than 8 runs (i.e., 9 or more runs),
- The match was a T20I (not domestic T20),
- Both teams scored more than 100 runs (i.e., each side 101+),
AND the player’s personal data meet BOTH conditions:
- Date of birth from 1980 through 1999 inclusive,
- Test debut between 2010 and 2019 inclusive.

Output requirements:
- Produce a deduplicated list of candidate player NAMES (men only) who satisfy ALL of the above via at least one qualifying T20I before 2023.
- For each player, provide:
 1) Player full name.
 2) DOB and Test debut date (day-month-year). Confirm Test debut year falls within 2010–2019 inclusive. Provide ESPNcricinfo player-profile link.
 3) At least one qualifying match (can include multiple if easily available):
 - Date, venue, teams (Team A vs Team B), match result.
 - Confirmation that match type is T20I and date is before 2023.
 - Explicit MOTM/POTM recipient as this player.
 - This player’s bowling figures (overs–maidens–runs–wickets). Confirm wickets ≥3 and runs conceded ≥9.
 - Final team totals for both sides (each must be 101+). If DLS was used, still confirm final totals and that both exceeded 100.
 - ESPNcricinfo scorecard link and quote the relevant fragments (award, totals, bowling figures) to show compliance.
- If a player otherwise fits but does NOT have a Test debut in 2010–2019 or DOB outside 1980–1999, exclude them.
- If multiple matches qualify for the same player, it’s sufficient to list one, but note if more exist.
- Flag any edge cases, uncertainties, or conflicting data (e.g., totals exactly 100, abandoned/shortened games, ambiguity in award wording). Clearly mark any candidates that are borderline and explain why.

Method suggestions:
- Use ESPNcricinfo Statsguru or records pages to find T20I Player of the Match instances where the award went to a bowler with ≥3 wickets; then check bowling runs conceded ≥9 and verify both teams’ totals ≥101 via the scorecard. Alternatively, search ESPNcricinfo match reports explicitly mentioning “Player of the Match” with 3+ wickets and then verify totals.
- Restrict to men’s T20Is. Exclude women’s matches and domestic leagues (IPL, BBL, etc.).
- Ensure dates are before 2023 (i.e., up to 2022-12-31 inclusive).
- Verify DOB and Test debut on the player’s ESPNcricinfo profile.

Deliverable format:
- Start with a short overview of your search strategy and coverage (e.g., Statsguru filters used, date range checked) and a note on how exhaustive the search is.
- Then provide a numbered list of all candidate players. For each, present structured bullet points for (DOB/Test debut with link) and (qualifying match details with link and quoted lines proving each criterion). Keep quotations concise but specific (e.g., lines showing “Player of the Match”, bowling figures, and team totals).
- After the list, add a section for Edge cases and uncertainties (if any), and a brief discussion of completeness or potential gaps.

Important constraints:
- Treat “more than 100” as 101 or higher; “more than two wickets” as 3 or more; “more than 8 runs conceded” as 9 or more.
- Use authoritative sources (ESPNcricinfo preferred); include direct URLs.
- Be careful not to include domestic T20s.
- Keep to players whose Test debut year is 2010–2019 and DOB is 1980–1999 inclusive.
